verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 3.4.1 give 6.61 x 10-4 S/cm at 250C (25 °C, with the degree sign garbled) for the 0.25 Ta ceramic. The sintering at 10500 C (1050 °C) for 7.30 h, the 0.25 eV activation energy, the solid-state route, and the Ge/Ta dopants all match the paper. The null relative density is correct because the paper gives no percent value.

Section 3.4.1 states the total conductivity of the 0.25 Ta ceramic after 5 months of air exposure is 5.95 x 10-4 S/cm, read from Fig. 4(c). The paper gives no temperature for this value, so the null temperature is correct. The sintering conditions are those of the same 0.25 Ta composition, and the null activation energy is correct.
